items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: we would co-produce, like Dave Garroway in Chicago or Rush Hughes in St. Louis

ctx.x: And then when I would go someplace like Chicago or St. Louis, I would work with whoever was the disc jockey that had the jazz audience. And we would co-produce, like Dave Garroway in Chicago or Rush Hughes in St. Louis, that kind of thing. And I worked out a little route, you know, for jazz bands. Uh-huh. And everybody has worked for me. Uh-huh. And there was also even a time when I had a foray into bebop, because there were so many, uh, of the people who were interested in the music that I was producing, that…
